title: Job Application and CV / Gushakisha kuri kazi na CV
bridge: Mu gaciriyubwenge, dusubira twibwira ko 'mfite imyaka 25' cyangwa 'nari we byanguye mu Turisimwe', ariko mu Icyongereza, ubwoko bw’inyuguti bihinduka: tubona umubwiriza ‘to have’ n’amagambo menshi nk’ ‘in’ cyangwe ‘from’. Nanone, reba neza kuri ubwoko bw’ ‘experience’ (nta ‘experiences’ mu biho by’ibintu by’umunyama), kandi ubwoko bw’igitangaza bigaragara inyuma y’izina, ibintu by’icyongereza byagenewe. Nta na kimwe wigeze ubika ‘me dedico a’ kuba ‘I dedicate myself to’, kubera ko byibuka cyane; mu Icyongereza, tubwira ‘I work as’ cyangwe ‘I am responsible for’.
rule: Kugira ngo ubwirane ku byerekeye ubushakashatsi bwawe mu cyongereza ku murongo B1: 1) Bona ubwoko bw’impera kugira ubusobanuro ku kazi wako uwo mubiri: 'I work as a...' (Nyakora kuba...), 'I am responsible for...' (Ndahemuka kuri...). 2) Ku byerekeye ubushakashatsi bw’aho, bona ‘used to’ cyangwe ubwoko bw’aho: 'I used to work at...' / 'I worked at...'. 3) Umubwiriza ‘have’ ubonwa kugira ngo ubusobanuro ku myaka n’ubwoko bw’ubushakashatsi: 'I have five years of experience' (Mfite imyaka 5 y’ubushakashatsi). 4) Igitangaza bigaragara inyuma y’izina: 'I have strong communication skills' (nta ‘skills strong’). 5) Bona ‘in’ kuri ibice birenga (‘experience in hospitality’), ‘at’ kuri ibikorwa (‘at a hotel’), na ‘as’ kuri ibikorwa (‘as a manager’). 6) Mu CV, tubona ibice by’ibintu by’umunyama byinshi by’amabwiriza mu bwoko bw’aho cyangwe bw’aho, nta mwisubizo y’ibintu by’umunyama.

Rebera: 'I am + nimero + years old' na 'graduate from' cyangwe 'have a degree in'.

title: Discussing current events / Kuganira iby’ubushakashatsi n’iby’ubwami
bridge: Mu gaciri, harakoreshwa gushimisha imyaka itandukanye n’amakuru, kandi harakoreshwa amagambo nk’ ‘by’ukuri’ cyangwa ‘bisezerano’. Mu Icyongereza, ni by’ingenzi kugiraw’imyaka itandukanye makuru ya kera (ntese ‘by’ukuri byageze’) n’imyaka itandukanye y’ibintu bikomeye. Ubundi, imyaka itandukanye y’ibintu bikomeye (ntese ‘by’ukuri byageze’) harakoreshwa cyane mu Icyongereza kugira ngo ubushakashatsi bwagombaye. Ubwokozi bw’ibibi ni guhindura ‘by’ukuri byageze’ kuva mu ‘by’ukuri byageze’ mu gihe koko harakoreshwa imyaka itandukanye y’ibintu bikomeye kugira ngo ibintu bikomeye.
rule: Kugira ngo ubushakashatsi bwagombaye mu Icyongereza mu matora B1: 1. Shimisha imyaka itandukanye y’ibintu bikomeye (have/has + umubare w’imyaka) kugira ngo ubushakashatsi bwagombaye bwatangiye: ‘Abashakashatsi bafite amakuru menshi.’ 2. Shimisha imyaka itandukanye y’ibintu bikomeye kugira ngo ubushakashatsi bwagombaye bwatangiye: ‘Abashakashatsi bafite amakuru menshi.’ 3. Shimisha imyaka itandukanye y’ibintu bikomeye kugira ngo ubushakashatsi bwagombaye bwatangiye: ‘Abashakashatsi bafite amakuru menshi.’ 4. Kugira ngo ubushakashatsi bwagombaye mu Icyongereza mu matora B1: 1. Shimisha imyaka itandukanye y’ibintu bikomeye (have/has + umubare w’imyaka) kugira ngo ubushakashatsi bwagombaye bwatangiye: ‘Abashakashatsi bafite amakuru menshi.’ 5. Amagambo yo kwiga: ‘headline’, ‘article’, ‘report’, ‘according to’, ‘latest’, ‘issue’.

title: Cultural Differences and Misunderstandings / Imiterere n’ibinyoma mu bukungu
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, dusaba gufata neza cyangwa kuguma amahoro mu buryo bungana burambuye, kandi mu gaciriyani bahagarara kubara indimi zifite ubwoko bwa kumenya neza n’ubwoko bwa kumenya neza, nk’uko ‘Ndabwira...’ cyangwa ‘Ntekereza...’. Nanone, mu gaciriyani ibinyoma birindurwa kenshi n’ibibazo by’ububiko (‘Ese wibwira...?’), kandi mu ikinyarwanda ni byinshi kubika cyangwa kugumana. Kandi wemeye gusaba amakuru y’ububiko n’amagambo nk’ ‘Wibwira iki?’ ahandi kubika yuko waramaze gutanga neza. Ibi na byo bikwiye kugirwa n’ubwoko bwa kumenya neza: mu gaciriyani bahagarara kubara ubwoko bwa kumenya neza kugira ngo babikire ibikorwa bifite ubwoko bwa kumenya neza, kandi mu ikinyarwanda kenshi bahagarara kubara ubwoko bwa kumenya neza kugira ngo babikire ibikorwa bifite ubwoko bwa kumenya neza by’ubushishozi.
rule: Kugira ngo ubuire utanze imiterere n’ibinyoma mu bukungu mu gaciriyani ku mubare w’B1, byakwiye kumenya neza: 1) Ibibazo bihambaye: ‘Wishobora kugaragaza ibyo?’ ahandi ‘Garagaza ibyo’. 2) Amagambo y’uburyo bw’uburyo: ‘Ndabwira’, ‘Ndikumva’, ‘Ndabwira’ kugira ngo ntushimire kuri muntu. 3) Ibibazo by’ububiko: ‘Ese wibwira...?’, ‘Ese ubwira...?’ kugira ngo ubone ibyo yari avuze. 4) Kubara ubwoko bwa kumenya neza kugira ngo ubikore ibikorwa by’ubushishozi: ‘Nari ninyoma’ (si ‘Nari ninyoma’ niba ntibifite ububiko n’ubushishozi). Ihinda ry’ubushishozi ‘gutanga neza’ (to be right, si ‘to have reason’) n’ihinda ry’ubushishozi ‘gutanga neza’ (to need, si ‘to make lack’).

title: Discussing Environmental Topics / Kuganira iby’umwuka
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugirango tusuzume ibikorwa bifuzwa mu gihe kihuje, tubikoresha ubwoko bw’imperatifi ‘dusiga’ cyangwa ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro ‘turi kusiya’ kandi buri wundi ubwoko aha ari umwe. Mu Icyongereza, gutandukanya ibyo bikorwa ni cyo cyabanza: ubwoko bw’imperatifi ‘we pollute’ buvuga iby’amahanga cyangwa ibintu by’ingene, nyamara ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro ‘we are polluting’ buvuga ibikorwa by’ubushake. Nanone, mu Icyongereza, kugirango tusuzume ibikorwa by’aho buzima bumeze (nk’uko ni ‘We are going to reduce waste’), tubikoresha ‘be going to’ cyangwa ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro, nyamara mu gaciri tuvugisha ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro (‘reduciremos’). Reba neza n’uburyo ‘should’ bukoreshwa kugirango dufate amahame, ibyo mu gaciri bikorwa n’ubwoko bw’imperatifi ‘deberíamos’.
rule: Kugirango usuzume iby’umwuka mu Icyongereza ku murongo wa B1, wihagije gufatanya: 1) Ubwoko bw’imperatifi (iby’amahanga: ‘The planet is warming’ – nyamara aha ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro bukoreshwa kubera ko ni ubwoko bw’ubushake; kuri by’ingene: ‘Climate change affects everyone’), 2) Ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro (ibikorwa by’ubushake: ‘Forests are disappearing’), 3) ‘be going to’ + ingingo (iby’aho buzima bumeze: ‘We are going to install solar panels’), na 4) ‘should’ + ingingo (amahame: ‘You should recycle more’). Rebera ko mu Icyongereza, ubwoko bw’imperatifi bukoranyonwa na ‘-s’ mu gitondo cy’umuntu w’umwe (he/she/it). Kuri ‘there is/are’ (hari), rebera ko ‘there is’ ni kuri wundi, ‘there are’ ni kuri benshi. Nanone, koresha ibiganisha nk’uko ni ‘because’, ‘so’, ‘therefore’ kugirango uhangane ibirimo. Ntukarebe ko amajambo yo kuganira bikuye mu Icyongereza kurusha ingingo (‘renewable energy’, si ‘energy renewable’).

concept_examples.text: We are reducing our carbon footprint by using public transport.
concept_examples.translation: Turi kumaza imipaka yacu yo ku mazi koresha uburemere bw’abanyarwanda.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ˈaʊər ˈkɑːrbən ˈfʊtprɪnt baɪ ˈjuːzɪŋ ˈpʌblɪk ˈtrænspɔːrt/

concept_examples.text: Climate change affects everyone, but we can still make a difference.
concept_examples.translation: Igihindwa cy’umwuka kiratera abandi bose, nyamara tubona tugomba kugira ububasha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ əˈfɛkts ˈɛvriwʌn, bʌt wiː kæn stɪl meɪk ə ˈdɪfərəns/

concept_examples.text: If we don't act now, the planet will suffer serious consequences.
concept_examples.translation: N’ubwo tubikorwa ubu, isi izaza igasuzugura ibyago by’ingene.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt ækt naʊ, ðə ˈplænɪt wɪl ˈsʌfər ˈsɪriəs ˈkɒnsɪkwənsɪz/

concept_examples.text: You should replace plastic bags with reusable ones.
concept_examples.translation: Wowe ushaka kugura ibyuma by’ubwoko bw’umukindo, koresha ibyuma byo kwinjirira.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd rɪˈpleɪs ˈplæstɪk bæɡz wɪð riːˈjuːzəbəl wʌnz/

common_error.wrong: We are recycle the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.correct: We recycle the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.correct_alt: We are recycling the plastic bottles in our house.
common_error.explanation: Ibikorwa by’ikibazo ni ukubera ko harimo ubwibone rw’ubwoko bw’imperatifi na rw’ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro. Mu gaciri, ‘reciclamos’ bishobora kuba iby’amahanga cyangwa ibikorwa by’ubushake. Mu Icyongereza, n’ubwo ni iby’amahanga cyangwa iby’ubushake, koresha ubwoko bw’imperatifi (‘recycle’); n’ubwo ni ibikorwa by’ubushake by’ubushake, koresha ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro (‘are recycling’). Ntukoreshe ‘are recycle’ – ingingo zikuru zikwiye kuba zifite ‘-ing’ mu bwoko bw’urupapuro.

examples.original: Air pollution is a serious problem in many cities.
examples.phonetic: /ɛər pəˈluːʃən ɪz ə ˈsɪriəs ˈprɒbləm ɪn ˈmɛni ˈsɪtiz/
examples.translation: Ubwato bw’amazi ni ikibazo cy’ingene mu miji menshi.
examples.note: Koresha ‘is’ kuri by’ingene. Rebera ko ‘pollution’ ni igisubizo cy’umwe, bityo ntukoreshe ‘a pollution’.

examples.original: The oceans are getting warmer because of climate change.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈoʊʃənz ɑːr ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈwɔːrmər bɪˈkɒz əv ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ/
examples.translation: Amazi y’akabo ari kuguma kubera igihindwa cy’umwuka.
examples.note: Koresha ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro ‘are getting’ kugirango usuzume ubushake bw’ubushake.

examples.original: There is too much plastic waste in the environment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz tuː mʌtʃ ˈplæstɪk weɪst ɪn ðə ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
examples.translation: Hari ibintu byinshi by’ubwoko bw’umukindo mu mazi.
examples.note: Koresha ‘there is’ na amajambo yo kuganira ibintu by’umwe nk’uko ni ‘waste’. Ntukore ‘there are waste’.

examples.original: Deforestation destroys the habitat of many animals.
examples.phonetic: /ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən dɪˈstrɔɪz ðə ˈhæbɪtæt əv ˈmɛni ˈænɪməlz/
examples.translation: Gutumba ibiti biratera imirimo y’inama menshi.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’imperatifi kuri by’ingene. Rebera ‘-s’ mu gitondo cy’umuntu w’umwe: ‘destroys’.

examples.original: We are planting more trees in our neighborhood.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr ˈplæntɪŋ mɔːr triːz ɪn ˈaʊər ˈneɪbərhʊd/
examples.translation: Turi gutura ibiti byinshi mu rugo rwacu.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’imperatifi bw’urupapuro kuri ibikorwa by’ubushake. ‘Plant’ bihinduka ‘planting’.

examples.original: Our school is going to start a recycling program.
examples.phonetic: /ˈaʊər skuːl ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ˈproʊɡræm/
examples.translation: Ishuli ryacu rizaba ryazaba rimeze uburyo bw’ukuri bw’ubushake.
examples.note: Koresha ‘be going to’ kuri iby’aho buzima bumeze. ‘Is going to’ bishobora kugwa mu kuganira k’umunsi.

examples.original: We should use less electricity to save energy.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ʃʊd juːz lɛs ɪlɛkˈtrɪsɪti tə seɪv ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Twemere kugura amafaranga menshi kugirango dufite amafaranga menshi.
examples.note: ‘Should’ bikurikiyo ingingo zikuru (bitandukanye na ‘to’). ‘Less’ kuri ibintu by’umwe; ‘fewer’ kuri ibintu byinshi.

examples.original: If everyone recycles, we will reduce pollution.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ˈɛvriwʌn riːˈsaɪkəlz, wiː wɪl rɪˈdjuːs pəˈluːʃən/
examples.translation: N’ubwo buri wese yerekana, tuzamaza ubwato bw’amazi.
examples.note: Ikinyejana cya mbere: ‘if’ + ubwoko bw’imperatifi, ‘will’ + ingingo. ‘Everyone’ ni umuntu w’umwe.

examples.original: I think that electric cars are a good investment for the future.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ɪˈlɛktrɪk kɑːrz ɑːr ə ɡʊd ɪnˈvɛstmənt fɔːr ðə ˈfjuːtʃər/
examples.translation: Ntekereza ko imodoka z’amafaranga ni ububasha bwiza kuri buzima bumeze.
examples.note: Koresha ‘I think that’ kuri ibiranga. Nyuma ya ‘think’, ‘that’ ni ikimenyetso cyo kuganira.

examples.original: In my opinion, recycling should be mandatory in every city.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətəri ɪn ˈɛvri ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Mu biranga byanjye, gutura ibiti birabujijwe mu miji yose.
examples.note: ‘In my opinion’ + ‘should be’. ‘Recycling’ ni igisubizo, bityo ingingo ni umwe.

examples.original: The government should invest more in renewable energy sources.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnjuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi ˈsɔːrsɪz/
examples.translation: Serukwizi irabujijwe kwinjira mu mafaranga yo mu mazi yo mu mazi.
examples.note: Mahame na ‘should’. ‘Renewable’ ni ijambo ry’ubwoko bw’umwe, bityo rikuye kurusha ingingo.

examples.original: If we don't stop deforestation, many species will become extinct.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt stɒp ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən, ˈmɛni ˈspiːʃiːz wɪl bɪˈkʌm ɪkˈstɪŋkt/
examples.translation: N’ubwo dutaye gutumba ibiti, inama menshi zizaza zikwiriye.
examples.note: Ikinyejana cya mbere na ‘if we don’t’. ‘Species’ ni umuntu w’umwe na benshi.

title: Talking About Technology and Social Media / Kuganira ku byo ku mugenzi n’ibiri ku mitoyo y’ubwoko
bridge: Mu igifaransa, harakaze tubona ubwoko bw’imishi y’imisi kugiranganira ubwoko bw’ibintu n’ibintu byo ku mugenzi (ahamagarika ‘ubusa njye nkubona telefoni yanjye’), ariko mu icyongereza, ubwoko bw’imishi y’imisi n’ubwoko bw’ibintu byo ku mugenzi ni by’ingirakamaro. Nanone, kuganira ku byo ku mugenzi, abanyacyongereza bashobora kugira ubwoko bw’ibintu nk’uko ‘nifashishije kwica’ cyangwa ‘nifuze amafoto’, ariko mu icyongereza bashobora kugira ‘I have to click’ cyangwa ‘I like the photo’ bigaragaza ko bashobora kugira ubwoko bw’ibintu. Reba neza iby’ubwoko bw’ibintu (nk’uko ‘log in’, ‘sign up’) ibitabangwa n’ubwoko bw’ibintu mu igifaransa kandi bitubwiye n’ubwoko bw’ibintu.
rule: Kuganira ku byo ku mugenzi n’ibiri ku mitoyo y’ubwoko mu icyongereza ku murongo B1, onga: 1) Ubwoko bw’imishi y’imisi kugiranganira ubwoko bw’ibintu n’ibintu (I check my phone every morning). 2) Ubwoko bw’ibintu byo ku mugenzi kugiranganira ibintu byo ku mugenzi (I am scrolling through Instagram right now). 3) Imishi y’ubwoko bw’ibintu kugiranganira ubwoko bw’ibintu n’ubushobozi: can, should, must (You should update your password). 4) Ubwoko bw’ibintu bw’ibintu: log in, log out, sign up, turn on, turn off, set up. 5) Ibiganiro n’ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘like’ n’‘share’ (I like the post, She shared the video). Reba ko mu icyongereza ntibitondetse ‘social media’ (I spend time on social media, ntibitondetse ‘in the social media’). Nanone, kugiranganira ubwubaka n’ibintu byo ku mugenzi tubona ‘have’ (I have a new phone) kandi ntibitondetse ‘tengo’ mu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘there is’.

concept_examples.text: I usually check my social media in the morning.
concept_examples.translation: Nkubona ibintu byanjye byo ku mugenzi ubusa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli tʃek maɪ ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She is posting a story on Instagram right now.
concept_examples.translation: Yaremye igitabu cy’ibintu byo ku mugenzi ku Instagram ubusa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈpoʊstɪŋ ə ˈstɔːri ɑːn ˈɪnstəɡræm raɪt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: You should log out of your account on public computers.
concept_examples.translation: Wibe kuhagarika kwifuza mu gacuru wawe ku kompyuta z’abantu benshi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd lɔːɡ aʊt əv jʊər əˈkaʊnt ɑːn ˈpʌblɪk kəmˈpjuːtərz/

concept_examples.text: Can you help me set up my new laptop?
concept_examples.translation: Wishobora kundekesha gukoresha ordi yawe y’ishya?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kæn juː hɛlp miː sɛt ʌp maɪ nuː ˈlæptɑːp/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct: I agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct_alt: I agree on that point about social media.
common_error.explanation: Mu igifaransa tubwira ‘ndamugiriye’, ariko mu icyongereza ‘agree’ ni ubwoko bw’ibintu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu kandi ntibitondetse mu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu. Kugirango ukunde ahantu, reba ko ‘agree’ ntibitondetse ‘be’ inyuma. Ubwoko bw’ibintu bw’ibintu ni ukubwira ‘I am agree’, ariko byiza ni ukubwira ‘I agree’. Nanone, wishobora kugira ‘I agree with you’ (ndamugiriye) cyangwa ‘I agree on that’ (ndamugiriye ku byo).

levels.label: Basic Vocabulary and Phrases for Tech
levels.translation: Ubwoko bw’ibintu n’ibiganiro by’ibintu byo ku mugenzi

examples.original: I need to charge my phone.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə tʃɑːrdʒ maɪ foʊn/
examples.translation: Nifunze gukoresha telefoni yanjye.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘charge’ bigaragaza gukoresha (batterie). Mu igifaransa harakaze tubona ‘charger’ kugiranganira telefoni, ariko mu icyongereza ntibitondetse ‘load’ mu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu.

examples.original: My laptop is very slow.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæptɑːp ɪz ˈvɛri sloʊ/
examples.translation: Ordi yanjye irarengagiza cyane.
examples.note: Reba ko mu icyongereza ‘slow’ bitubwiye kugiranganira uburyo bw’ubushakashatsi bw’ordi, nk’ubwoko bw’ibintu mu igifaransa, ariko ntibigirire ‘late’ (tarde).

examples.original: Do you have a charger?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈtʃɑːrdʒər/
examples.translation: Ubone impanuro?
examples.note: Ibaze ry’ibiganiro ry’ibiganiro. Reba ko ‘charger’ ni impanuro, ntibitondetse ‘loader’.

examples.original: I'm scrolling through my feed.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈskroʊlɪŋ θruː maɪ fiːd/
examples.translation: Nkubona ibintu byanjye byo ku mugenzi.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘scroll through’ bitubwiye kugiranganira gutura ku mugenzi. Mu igifaransa tubwira ‘deslizar’ cyangwa ‘hacer scroll’, ariko mu icyongereza tubona ‘scroll’ nk’ubwoko bw’ibintu.

examples.original: She uploaded a new video yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ʌpˈloʊdɪd ə nuː ˈvɪdioʊ ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Yaremye vidiyo yishya byarema.
examples.note: Mu icyongereza ‘upload’ bitubwiye kugiranganira gutura ibintu; mu igifaransa harakaze tubona ‘subir’ ariko nanone ‘montar’ mu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu. Hano tubona ubwoko bw’ibintu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu.

examples.original: He liked my post and commented.
examples.phonetic: /hiː laɪkt maɪ poʊst ænd ˈkɑːmɛntɪd/
examples.translation: Yaramutse yifuze igitabu cyanjye kandi yabwiye.
examples.note: Reba ko mu icyongereza tubwira ‘he liked’ (ntibitondetse ‘he liked it’ nibwo byagaragaye) kandi ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘like’ ntibitondetse ubwoko bw’ibintu nk’ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘le gustó’.

examples.original: Are you following that influencer?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr juː ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ ðæt ˈɪnfluənsər/
examples.translation: Urakoze kwinjiza uyu mwinshi?
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘follow’ bitubwiye ku mitoyo y’ubwoko. Mu igifaransa harakaze tubona ‘seguir’ nanone, ariko mu icyongereza ni nk’ubwoko bw’ibintu. Reba ubwoko bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu kugiranganira ibaze.

levels.label: Discussing Pros and Cons of Social Media
levels.translation: Kuganira iby’ubwoko n’iby’ubwoko by’ibiri ku mitoyo y’ubwoko

examples.original: Social media can be addictive.
examples.phonetic: /ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə kæn biː əˈdɪktɪv/
examples.translation: Ibiri ku mitoyo y’ubwoko birashobora kuba byinshi.
examples.note: Tubona ubwoko bw’ibintu ‘can’ kugiranganira ubushobozi. Mu igifaransa tubwira ‘pueden ser’, ariko mu icyongereza ubwoko bw’ibintu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu ntibishyirwa ku bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu.

examples.original: One advantage is that you can connect with people worldwide.
examples.phonetic: /wʌn ədˈvæntɪdʒ ɪz ðæt juː kæn kəˈnɛkt wɪð ˈpiːpəl ˈwɜːrldwaɪd/
examples.translation: Ububiko ni ukuntu wishobora kwinjiza n’abantu b’isi yose.
examples.note: Hano tubona ‘one advantage’ kugiranganira ibintu by’ububiko. Mu igifaransa tubwira ‘una ventaja es que’, ariko mu icyongereza ubwoko bw’ibintu ni nk’ubwoko bw’ibintu.

examples.original: However, it can waste a lot of time.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈɛvər, ɪt kæn weɪst ə lɑːt əv taɪm/
examples.translation: Nyamara, birashobora gushisha ubwoko bw’ibintu.
examples.note: Ijambo ‘however’ ni ubwoko bw’ibintu bw’ubwoko bw’ibintu. Mu igifaransa tubona ‘sin embargo’. Reba ko ‘waste’ bigaragaza gushisha, ntibigirire ‘spend’ (gutura ubwoko bw’ibintu).

examples.original: I think it's better to limit screen time.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ˈbɛtər tə ˈlɪmɪt skriːn taɪm/
examples.translation: Ntekereza ko byiza kugirango ukunde ubwoko bw’ibintu.
examples.note: Tubona ‘it’s better to’ + infinitivo kugiranganira ibiganiro. Mu igifaransa tubwira ‘es mejor que limites’, ariko mu icyongereza tubona ‘to limit’.

translations.rw: Ibintu bya mugenzi n’ibiri ku mitoyo y’ubwoko
